An excellent menu of gourmet pizza, pasta and appetisers with very friendly staff.
Feb 2025 • Friends
I've been to 4 different 4P's locations here in HCM but this is by far the friendliest place. Located at the top of Saigon Centre, the atmosphere is quiet and peaceful with a smoking section outside.

Menu is the same as every other 4P's but if you've never been then you'll find a whole range of gourmet pizza available along with delectable appetisers such as your casual fried chicken to your more fancier prosciutto wrapped mango salads. My friends and I chose two half and half pizza, a pepperoni chorizo / spicy kebab and mushroom cheese / ham prosciutto. 

Prices are more than your average restaurant but still very affordable. For 4 people, we got 2 half and half pizzas, 3 entrees, 1 pasta and 5 drinks which cost $80USD.

Ordering was done via QR code and very user friendly with pictures so you know what you're getting.

Service staff were amazing and very friendly too.

Definitely worth a visit.
